name: house-rules
description: The rules that hold on every turn, the skills that encode repeatable procedures, and the hooks that enforce them mechanically.

cost_before_clear.title: Cost before a clear
cost_before_clear.description: Every clear proposal, and the first reply after a clear, gives the cost of a message: tokens re-read each turn (context size), the session total, and the fill of the window. Off removes that standing rule from the session context.
